name: Idol Koukai Chijoku Sex
source:
My name is Taro. I work for a talent agency and am now in charge of Sakura, an idol talent. My goal is to make her a popular idol. However, her smile gradually disappears day by day.... It seems she is often harassed by someone unknown. Whenever I see her sad face, I feel my black desire arises.... When it finally bursts up, I decide to rape her....
